title: Sea Happy
meta_description: Greetings from Sea Happy, a bright and beachy 3BDR home in Prominence. With access to a resort-style community pool, it's perfect for your next getaway!
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Located in the vibrant Prominence community, Sea Happy is a bright and beachy retreat perfect for your next coastal getaway. With a seamless open floor plan connecting the living room, dining area, and fully equipped kitchen, this home is designed for relaxation and gathering. Step into the garage to find a unique entertainment space complete with a bar, arcade game, and TV, or head outside to the deck which offers cozy seating for enjoying warm evenings. The Prominence community enhances your stay with a resort-style pool, gym, and easy access to The Big Chill, where you can find dining, shopping, and live entertainment. With three serene bedrooms, Sea Happy is your ultimate vacation escape!

PROMINENCE POOL NOW HEATED October \& November AND March \& April

ABOUT THE AREA: Prominence is a charming coastal community nestled between Seagrove Beach and Alys Beach and just 20 minutes to Pier Park. The community features incredible amenities, open green spaces and easy access to over 17 miles of bike paths. Residents will enjoy easy access to a beautiful town center, 5,000 square foot resort style pool. In the heart of Prominence is The Big Chill (formerly the Hub), a family hot spot for dining, shopping and entertainment, featuring an outdoor 25 ft LED theater screen which streams major sporting events, movies under the stars as well as features live music on their very own stage.

BEACH ACCESS: Deer Lake State Park: This state park is roughly 1/2 mile from Prominence. There is an entry fee of $3 per vehicle (2 to 8 passengers) or $2 per pedestrian, bicyclist, and extra passengers. There is a long scenic boardwalk that brings you from the parking lot to the beach and is a five-to-ten minute walk. Beach service is not provided here. Walton Dunes: located 2.5 miles from the Prominence area, Walton Dunes is an easily accessible beach entrance! Unlike Deer Lake, there are no stairs/ramps and you can walk right up to the beach. You take a left at Lakewood Drive and follow the curve until you see the parking lot for cars. Beach service is the only amenity provided. Santa Clara: located 3.5 miles away and is ADA accessible, has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located on Scenic 30A, 1/2 mile east of Scenic 395, turn south on Bramble Grove Place.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King, Ensuite (2nd floor)
• Bedroom 2 -- King (2nd floor)
• Bedroom 3 -- Full over full bunk bed (2nd floor)

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Pet Friendly ($250/pet NR fee)
• 2 Bikes
• Less than 2 miles to beach access
• Located in Prominence community
• Access to 5,000 sqft resort-style pool
• Primary bedroom with private ensuite bathroom
• Deck with outdoor seating
• Full size laundry room
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash cloths, etc.
• Starter kit: toilet paper, paper towels, dishwasher and washing machine pods, trash bags, kitchen towels, bar of soap for shower
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- This home allows up to 2 pets under 50 lbs each for a fee; undisclosed pets brought without AvantStay's approval may result in a $500 fine.

Parking Details:
- 2 parking spaces available.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
